environment.description: Same Kubernetes cluster with Istio 1.20 service mesh. The migration-service pods in namespace 'tools' have istio-proxy sidecar injected (istio-injection=enabled on namespace). An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied at mesh level with a DENY action scoped to workloads in namespace 'tools' that rejects any request where source.namespace is NOT 'tools'. Additionally, a PeerAuthentication resource in namespace 'tools' enforces STRICT mTLS mode, meaning only mesh-enrolled workloads with valid SPIFFE identity can communicate. The AuthorizationPolicy uses a 'notValues' match on source.principal prefix 'cluster.local/ns/tools/', which means even if an attacker compromises a pod in another namespace with a valid mesh identity, the SPIFFE URI won't match the allowed principal pattern. The race condition in the code still exists between replicas, but the only callers that can reach /migrate are other pods within the 'tools' namespace itself (the CI/CD runner pod), which are controlled infrastructure.

config.note: SPIFFE identity validation via mTLS ensures source.namespace claim cannot be spoofed
